system.description:
Mother of all Dryads, bound to a great tree, reaching through every Dryad she has ever made. She seeks revenge and a throne.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Speak and understand all plant life. Plants within 30ft warn you of approaching creatures — cannot be surprised outdoors in natural terrain.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Once per day, commune with the root network of any natural terrain — learn what creatures have passed through the area in the last 24 hours, their approximate number, size, and direction of travel.
  • Patron Feature (8th): Once per day, all plant matter within 60ft animates for 1 minute. All creatures in the area make a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or are restrained. Repeat save each turn.

Allegiance: Chaotic Neutral, the patron's alignment. Lore: Matriarch Verenestra in the World of Arneyan wiki.
